provenance.text_quote: The Great Exhibition Road Festival is a free annual celebration of science and the arts each summer in South Kensington.

Imperial College will be the London satellite location for the Green Science Festival 2026, taking place in Amsterdam. We will be streaming the festival throughout the day, creating an opportunity for colleagues in London to drop in, connect, and engage with the programme locally.
